description: add_line shares one basket between calls when no basket is passed (mutable default argument)
ten units earn no discount (>= 10 became > 10)
invalid quantity text returns 0 instead of raising ValueError
fifty units earn only the 10 % tier (>= 50 became > 50)
half cents round to even instead of half-up
an item without a price is treated as free instead of raising UnknownItemError
non-ASCII digits such as Arabic-Indic numerals are accepted as quantities
